Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on 6-month bases as 
indicated by M6 in the title block
The technical specification of the oil pump : 
capacity Q:1.6-3.91/s, total head H: 14-20m, speed n:2900 rpm, power: 1.7 kw
The first draft is initiated and reviewed by eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr,
accepted by Pre.general director eng. Ahmed 
Saber Gabr, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector of 
High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.
This document certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem 
MPIS Hyd.EPCo. Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off Pump
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ... etc
Switch off Pump
Use suitable warning boards
Tools and Equipment
Set of wrenches and screwdrivers
Kerosene and cleaning material (rag. cloth)
Packing and grease
Work to be Carried Out
Carry out the outside inspection & to hear the pump in 
 operation before stoppage for the revision for the purpose of normal operation 
 of the bearings, vibrations, leakage through the sealing joints
Make the necessary cleaning
Check up the fastening of the pump and electric motor to the 
 base plate and also the state of foundation concrete
